title: Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2005, Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2005, Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the platform category, Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
